intro: The Valley of Kings is a lush canyon nestled in the southwestern corner of Loch Modan, directly south of the passage to Dun Morogh. It serves as a heavily watched gateway into the fiery Searing Gorge, flanked by monumental stone figures carved in memory of the War of the Three Hammers. Travelers venturing here walk beneath ancient dwarven history while facing the immediate threat of Blackrock encroachers and troggs.

p: The valley's most commanding feature is the pair of colossal statues depicting King Madoran Bronzebeard and High Thane Khardros Wildhammer. Carved by joint commission from their sons following their deaths, these stone titans overlook the pass into the scorched southlands. They stand as a lasting monument to the allied victory in the War of the Three Hammers and an eternal warning against the Dark Iron clan, reminding all who look south of the ruin brought upon the southlands by the summoning of Ragnaros.

sections.t: The Gate to the Searing Gorge
p: Beyond serving as a path between South Gate Pass and Stonesplinter Valley, the Valley of Kings holds the heavy iron gate leading down into the Searing Gorge. Because of the hostile Blackrock orcs, Dark Iron dwarves, and volcanic hazards lurking on the other side, the gate is kept strictly locked and guarded by Ironforge mountaineers. Mountaineer Pebblebitty keeps watch over the threshold, turning away all but the hardiest adventurers who can prove they possess the strength to survive the inferno beyond.
